description: AllTrails Pro annual price raised from 29.99 USD to 35.99 USD (about 20%); the paid tier was later branded AllTrails+/Plus.
notes: Date is the first Wayback snapshot showing 35.99 USD; the last snapshot showing 29.99 USD is 2022-08-17 (http://web.archive.org/web/20220817225753/https://www.alltrails.com/pro), so the true change falls in a 9-day window. The 2022-08-24 snapshot could not be read. No announcement found. Price held at 35.99 USD through 2026 (the Peak launch left Plus unchanged). Rename date from Pro to Plus is not yet established; the /plus URL first appears in snapshots on 2022-12-15. Feasibility (issue 5): 1,142 pre / 802 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks.

description: AllTrails Peak launched at 79.99 USD/year above the existing Plus tier (35.99 USD/year); Peak-only features include custom routes, detailed trail conditions, and community heatmaps; Outdoor Lens added later in summer.
notes: Official AllTrails press release dated 2025-05-12 (also at https://www.alltrails.com/press/alltrails-expands-membership-offering-with-alltrails-peak). Early access within weeks and global availability by June 2025 (phased rollout); price and Peak-only features corroborated by https://fieldmag.com/articles/alltrails-peak-hiking-app-review. A third-party pricing site claims a 2024 launch and conflicts with all editorial and official sources. Feasibility (issue 5): 839 pre / 816 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks.

description: Garmin Connect+ premium plan announced at 6.99 USD/month or 69.99 USD/year with a 30-day trial: Active Intelligence insights, Performance Dashboard, Live Activity, training guidance, expanded LiveTrack, badge challenges. Garmin states all existing Connect features remain free.
notes: First time Garmin charged for app features; independent walkthrough at https://dcrainmaker.com/2025/03/garmin-connect-plus-subscription-walkthrough.html (published 2025-03-27). Garmin said on its Q1 2025 earnings call that more features will move into Connect+ (reported 2025-05-08: https://www.forbes.com/sites/andrewwilliams/2025/05/08/more-future-garmin-watch-features-will-be-locked-behind-the-connect-paywall/). Backlash coverage: https://www.ghacks.net/2025/03/31/garmins-new-subscription-service-sparks-backlash-from-users/. Feasibility (issue 5): 851 pre / 1,513 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks.

description: Strava ended individual Summit packs (Safety, Training, Analysis; 2.99 USD/month each) and moved subscribers to a single full Summit membership (4.99 to 7.99 USD/month by payment method). Single-pack users keep full access until 2020-07-15, then must pay the full rate or move to the free plan.
notes: Date is the publication date of the report; the change began about two weeks earlier. Falls two months before the 2020-05-18 gating event, so the two windows overlap and cannot be separated cleanly. Feasibility (issue 5): 1,588 pre / 2,022 post Strava reviews, but the Nike Run Club history reachable on Google Play starts 2020-04-12, so the control has 0 reviews in the pre-window; descriptive event study only, excluded from difference-in-differences.

description: Full segment leaderboards (and filters), segment effort analysis and comparison, matched runs, and the web route builder moved to subscribers only; free users keep the top-10 leaderboard view. Segment leaderboard API endpoint removed for all third-party apps.
notes: Effective immediately on the publication date; API changes live 10 AM Pacific. Strava also consolidated its tiered plans into a single subscription. Feasibility (issue 5): 2,070 pre / 2,848 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks.

description: Reports of Strava subscription price increases surfaced (UK monthly 6.99 to 8.99 GBP; US new-subscriber pricing about 79 USD/year and 12.99 USD/month per the source's own test). Strava published no price list and said changes vary by region and platform.
notes: Date is first public reporting, not a Strava announcement; rollout was staggered (UK reportedly earlier in late 2022) and users were notified individually before renewal. Renewal prices applied to renewals on or after 2023-02-02; subscribers who joined after 2022-11-23 reportedly exempt for now. Strava later apologized for the lack of transparency; exact apology date not yet verified. Feasibility (issue 5): 533 pre / 651 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks.

description: Athlete Intelligence (AI-generated workout summaries and insights) launched in public beta for subscribers only; not a removal of a free feature.
notes: Also reported by https://runningmagazine.ca/the-scene/strava-launches-ai-powered-guidance-feature-for-athletes/. Candidate only: new paid feature, not a gating of an existing one. Reports say the opt-out was later removed (around July to August 2026); not recorded as a row because the exact date is unsourced. Feasibility (issue 5): 1,035 pre / 1,016 post Google Play reviews in +/-8 weeks; new paid feature rather than a gating, so treat as a placebo-style comparison.

description: Revised API terms limited third-party apps to showing a user's data only to that user and barred use of API data in AI models. Strava said fewer than 0.1% of apps would be affected.
notes: Candidate only: a developer-terms change rather than a price or paywall event; likely drop at the feasibility stage. Effective date is from a single source and Strava's clarification is dated 2024-11-20 (https://the5krunner.com/2024/11/20/strava-issues-clarification/). Overlaps the 2024-10-03 row. Feasibility (issue 5): review volume is sufficient (1,016 pre / 1,096 post) but the event is a developer-terms change, not a price or paywall event, and overlaps the 2024-10-03 window.

description: Surfline introduced Premium+ as its highest tier, adding AI Smart Cam features (Wave Timeline, Wave Distribution, Crowd, Smart Clips) at select US spots for web and iOS.
notes: Date from a syndicated press release (a single source; the Surfline-hosted original was not retrievable). Launch price not confirmed; Premium+ lists at 149.99 USD/year in 2026 per third-party trackers. Feasibility (issue 5): only 44 pre / 46 post Google Play reviews (history reachable is about 600 reviews); descriptive only.

description: Surfline Premium (US) annual price raised from 99 USD to 119.99 USD (about 21%); new Premium with Ads tier at 69.99 USD/year; Premium+ at 149.99 USD/year now shareable with two other accounts.
notes: Effective date per Surfline support article (last updated 2025-05-05); members were emailed shortly before their renewal, so exposure dates vary by user. Wayback copy: http://web.archive.org/web/20260623223550/https://support.surfline.com/hc/en-us/articles/35208905809051-US-Price-Tier-Updates. Prior increase was July 2018 (95.88 USD for new subscribers, existing 69.99 USD rate grandfathered one year), outside the likely review window and not recorded as a row because the exact day is unsourced. Feasibility (issue 5): only 20 pre / 22 post Google Play reviews, below the 30-review floor; revisit with App Store data.
